content_sections.heading: MOIL Manager Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the MOIL Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download MOIL Manager (Medical Services) Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: M.B.B.S. from a recognized University/Institute. 1 year post internship experience in a Hospital. PG-Diploma in Gynaecology and Obstetrician/Paediatrics/ENT/Ophthalmology/Dermatology/Orthopaedic/Emergency Medicine/Hospital Administration is preferred.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age: 45 years Age relaxation is applicable as per Government guidelines for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-servicemen. Maximum age including relaxation not to exceed 53 years. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for MOIL Manager (Medical Services) Recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the MOIL Manager (Medical Services) recruitment is scheduled for 22nd September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the essential qualifications required for the Manager (Medical Services) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.B.B.S. degree from a recognized university or institute. A PG-Diploma in specific specializations is preferred, along with at least 1 year of post-internship experience in a hospital setting.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Manager (Medical Services) post is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Manager (Medical Services) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Manager (Medical Services) position by Manganese Ore India (MOIL).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Manager (Medical Services) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Manager (Medical Services) post will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the MOIL Manager (Medical Services) recruitment?
faq.answer: For General and OBC category candidates, the application fee is Rs. 590/- including GST. SC/ST category candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Manager (Medical Services) post will be based on a Walk-In-Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Nagpur, Maharashtra, at the address specified in the official notification. The pincode for the location is 440013.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the walk-in interview venue.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided as per Government guidelines for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-servicemen. The maximum age, including relaxation, should not exceed 53 years.
